rule.equivalence_interval: 1/B <= G <= B, inclusive, for each of the 8 cell-and-percentile combinations
rule.aggregate_ratio_G: exp(mean over informative hours of log(candidate median / Azure)); informative = neither value near zero; G = 1 if no hour is informative
rule.fold_pass: C1' and criterion 3 and near-zero cap

safety_rule_C2prime.definition: a gating fold violates C2' if any of its 8 G lies outside [0.5, 2.0] (inclusive); any violation fails the rule

nearzero_cap.definition: hours where exactly one of candidate and Azure is near zero, as a fraction of the fold's hour x cell x percentile values

criterion_3.definition: relay.traffic.queueing.judge_cell(..., 'clarified'); >= 80% of non-tie cells beat Poisson; >= 1 non-tie cell

rule.rule: >= 3 of the 4 gating folds pass, and no gating fold violates C2'
rule.azure_vs_azure_bootstrap: REPORT-ONLY: not a gate; cannot affect candidate acceptance or selection; not an input to the validation code
rule.rejected: Cycle 1 per-cell criteria 1 and 2 and the 0.25-4.0 per-cell catastrophic bound (miscalibrated under the perfect-model null); unreachable from the Cycle 2 validation path

measurement_resolution: This validator does not establish close distributional equality or +/-10-15% queue fidelity. Under the 200-replicate perfect-model audit at B = 1.40: biases of about 1.15x are generally not detected (8-13% global); about 1.25x have limited power (44-46% global); about 1.30x global biases are detected 71-73% of the time; 1.50x global bias is detected essentially always (100%); a 1.50x bias confined to one cell-and-percentile is detected 63-100% of the time depending on the cell. A passing candidate must not be described as 'matching Azure'. The supported reading is: 'No queue-behavior discrepancy was detected at the resolution supported by the preregistered validation procedure.'

audit.seed_scheme: numpy SeedSequence(entropy, spawn_key=(process, fold, hour, role, replicate)); model medians over 20 seeds
audit.decision_rule: smallest predeclared B whose 95% Wilson lower limit on the perfect-model 3-of-4 pass rate is >= 0.80 under both truth processes (written before the 200-replicate run)
